import builtins
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console output only: never opens or writes any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] started\n"


def test_log_line_writes_nothing_to_stderr(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "disk low")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.err == ""
    assert captured.out == "[WARN] disk low\n"


def test_log_line_returns_none(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    fn: Callable[[str, str], object] = log_line
    result = fn("DEBUG", "x")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert result is None


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] \n"


def test_log_line_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_log_line_preserves_message_text(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("error", "  spaced [brackets] %s {x}  ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[error]   spaced [brackets] %s {x}  \n"


def test_log_line_multiple_calls_in_order(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_log_line_does_not_open_files(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not touch the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)

    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"


def test_log_line_creates_no_files(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    log_line("INFO", "nothing on disk")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
